question: If the Chronicle/Sky farms are eligible for Distribution Rewards, which DR rate applies to them?
answer:
## What the Atlas Says

The atlas does not appear to explicitly document "Chronicle/Sky farms" as a named entity in the context of Distribution Rewards. However, here is what the atlas does establish about Distribution Reward rates:

### Standard Distribution Reward Rate

The **standard Distribution Reward rate is 0.2%**, annualized on all USDS and sUSDS balances associated with the relevant Reward Code:

> "The standard Distribution Reward rate is set at 0.2%. The Distribution Reward rate is annualized on all USDS and sUSDS balances associated with the relevant Reward Code."
> — [Distribution Reward Rate](/atlas/57384c49-e499-4c69-b22c-8e1f1dd34759) (A.2.2.9.1.2.1.2)

A second occurrence of the same 0.2% standard rate appears under the **Prime Program** within Active Ecosystem Accords:

> "The standard Distribution Reward rate is set at 0.2%."
> — [Distribution Reward Rate](/atlas/8e3cde6b-3b8b-4e9a-b9a0-8c24d84881f6) (A.2.8.2.2.2.3.1)

### Boosted Distribution Reward Rate

An **additional 0.3% Boosted Distribution Reward rate** will be available starting January 2026, at the discretion of Sky Governance:

> "An additional 0.3% Boosted Distribution Reward rate will be available starting January 2026 as specified in the documents herein. This Boosted Distribution Reward may be discontinued in the future at the discretion of Sky Governance."
> — [Boosted Distribution Reward Rate](/atlas/1d9219cb-9359-40de-96a0-ac60a8174c63) (A.2.2.9.1.2.1.2.1)

### Chronicle Point Reward Program (Separate from DR)

The atlas does define a **Chronicle Point Reward Program** (A.2.8.2.10.2.1), under which USDS deposited into Sky's Rewards contract accrues Chronicle Points. This is a distinct reward mechanism from the Distribution Reward Primitive and the atlas does not link it to a specific DR rate. See [Chronicle Point Reward Instance Definition](/atlas/a7ccb2d1-970e-4b91-a430-4173ade00396) (A.2.8.2.10.2.1.1).

### Bottom Line

If Chronicle/Sky farms are eligible for Distribution Rewards, the **standard 0.2% DR rate** would apply based on the global Distribution Reward Primitive specification. The **boosted 0.3% rate** (totaling 0.5%) may also apply starting January 2026 if they qualify, subject to Sky Governance discretion. The atlas does not contain a farm-specific override or special rate for "Chronicle/Sky farms" — if such a determination is needed, the relevant facilitator or governance process must decide.
